resources.string: Run this single-line command on your computer. Enter its address, an absolute folder path and the capability token to check the authenticated connection.
Use your own absolute token-file path. Keep the token private. Plain WebSocket is allowed only on this device; use a secure WebSocket for another computer.
The authenticated connection answered a folder-scoped read. An empty result does not confirm that the folder exists.
The connection check failed. Check that Codex is running and try again.
Codex refused the capability token. Check it and try again.
Check the address, absolute folder path and allowed connection scope.
This connection cannot supply account usage. Account reads require the qualified Codex 0.153.4 protocol.
The account reader is open. Open Plans to refresh the account limits. Close it here when finished.
This page checks the connection and reads account usage. It does not start a chat, sign you in or send a prompt.
